transition-ph1: Phase 1 priced a new Saguaro–Bianco–TS21 500 kV path and the Bianco 500/230 kV substation, $692M shared by 1.6 GW of NRIS. Q359 (315 MW) is the earliest-queued participant on all 14 upgrades.
transition-ph3a: After Q359 and Q537 converted to ERIS and Q388 and Q392 left, NRIS fell to 319 MW. The 500 kV build dropped out, leaving $70M of 230 kV reconductors and capacitors carried mostly by Q362.
2025-ph1: The 2025 cluster (1.7 GW NRIS) brings the 500 kV build back as a Saguaro–Bianco–Independence 500 kV line with two 600 MVA transformers at Bianco: $967M shared by 8 projects. Q604 and Q618 add $282M of 230 kV rebuilds. Q578 (300 MW) is the earliest-queued participant.
cluster-2026: 10 requests (4.9 GW, 2.8 GW NRIS), mostly at Saguaro 500/230 kV and Helios, the same corridor the 2025 cluster priced at $967M. Q661 and Q662 are 703 MW NRIS each at Saguaro 500 kV.
